999008199.text:
薬は作った、爆弾も作った……
あとは携帯食料ですね

localizations.en: The healing salves are done, the bombs are done... that just leaves the stamina rations.

999008199.text: みんな、どんなものが食べたいんだろ？

localizations.en: I wonder what everyone's in the mood for?

999008199.text:
拙者の忍びの携帯食、
兵糧丸を参考にされてはいかがでござるか？

localizations.en: Perhaps you might take inspiration from the ninja field ration—hyourougan. 'Tis a staple of covert operations.

999008199.text:
おお……ただの丸いかたまり。
これって美味しいの？

localizations.en: Ooh... it's just a plain round ball. Does it actually taste good?

999008199.text: 食べてみてもいいですか？
拙者が練ったものでよければ、どうぞお試しあれ

localizations.en: If you do not mind mine own handiwork, please, help yourself.

999008199.text: それじゃあ、お言葉に甘えて……

……ちょっと味気ないですね。
まずくはないですけど……

localizations.en: ...It's a little bland, isn't it? Not bad, but...

999008199.text:
まあ、兵糧丸は腹持ちと栄養重視で、
味は二の次でござるからなあ……

localizations.en: Well, hyourougan is all about staying power and nutrition. Taste is somewhat secondary, I'm afraid...

999008199.text:
とはいえ、味の改善にも取り組んでいるでござる！
その試作品が、こちら！

localizations.en: That said, I have been working on improving the flavor! Behold—these are my test batches!

999008199.text:
わあ……色とりどり、たくさんありますね。
あの、これ、レイニャも食べていいですか……？

localizations.en: Oh my... there are so many, and they're so colorful. Um, would it be alright if Lenja tried one...?

999008199.text: どうぞどうぞ、遠慮なく！

localizations.en: By all means, please help yourself!

999008199.text:
じゃあ、この赤くてかわいいのを、いただきます。
あむ……

localizations.en: Then... this cute little red one looks nice. Here goes... *nom*...

999008199.text:
お目が高い！　それは刺激的な食事をと思い、
激辛にしたものでござるよ！

localizations.en: An excellent choice! Wanting something with a bit of a kick, I made that one extra spicy!

999008199.text:
ひゃああああああ！！！
痛い！　舌が焼き切れそうです……！

localizations.en: Gyaaaahhhh!!! It burns! My tongue is on fire...!

999008199.text: だ、大丈夫？　ほら、牛乳飲んで……

localizations.en: Are you okay?! Here, drink some milk...

999008199.text:
ともかく、腹は膨れるのだろう？
なら、武道会には十分なんじゃないか

localizations.en: At the end of the day, it fills your stomach, right? That's enough for the tournament.

999008199.text: 同感だ。戦場では味より効能が重要だろう

localizations.en: Agreed. Out in the field, results matter more than flavor.

999008199.text:
ええー？　どうせ食べるなら、
やっぱり美味しいのがいいよ

localizations.en: Aw, come on! If you're going to eat something, it should at least taste good!

999008199.text:
アタシも！　
味が良くないと元気出ないよ

localizations.en: Same here! If it doesn't taste nice, how am I supposed to get pumped up?

999008199.text:
うん、そうだよね……美味しくて栄養もある
携帯食料のレシピを考えてみるよ

localizations.en: Yeah, you're both right... I'll come up with a recipe that's both delicious and nutritious.

999008199.text: 錬金術士の腕の見せどころだね！

localizations.en: Now that's a chance for an alchemist to show off!

999008199.text: あたしも調合手伝うよ！
……できた！　「みなぎるマフィン」！
うーん、いい匂い！　見た目もいい感じ！

localizations.en: Mmm, it smells amazing! And it looks great too!

999008199.text: 味見してみようよ！

いただきます！　……うん、美味しい！　
これならきっと、元気出ること間違いなしです！

localizations.en: Here goes! ...Mmm, delicious! These are sure to get everyone fired up!

999008199.text:
栄養価も十分。保存性も高い。
砂漠でも持つだろう

localizations.en: Nutritional value is sufficient. Shelf life looks good. Should hold up fine in the desert.

999008199.text:
これで、武道会の準備は整いました。
あとは本番を待つのみです……！

localizations.en: That's everything ready for the tournament. Now all we have to do is wait for the real thing...!
